name: smartfactory-mes-lite
description: 智能制造生产管理与 AI 辅助决策系统

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run build && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix backend && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix frontend
